root_cause: ACL 110 is applied inbound on the server subinterface, so it never sees guest-sourced traffic.

evidence.why: The deny line never matches guest traffic, so the ACL is never actually filtering it.
The ACL is bound inbound on the wrong subinterface.

next_command: show ip interface Gi0/0.99 | include access list
fix_steps: Apply it inbound on Gi0/0.30 instead
risk_notes: Applying it outbound on the server side would also filter return traffic.
